Gets pages and modules info from database

SELECT [TabID] ,[TabName] ,[Title] ,[Tabs].[IsDeleted] ,[Tabs].[TabPath] ,[Tabs].[CreatedByUserID] ,[Tabs].[CreatedOnDate] ,[Tabs].[LastModifiedByUserID] ,[Tabs].[LastModifiedOnDate] ,u1.Username as CreatedBy ,u2.Username as ModifiedBy FROM [dbo].[Tabs] LEFT JOIN Users u1 On [Tabs].CreatedByUserID = u1.UserID LEFT JOIN Users u2 On [Tabs].LastModifiedByUserID = u2.UserID

SELECT a.[ModuleID] ,t.[IsDeleted] ,t.[CreatedByUserID] ,t.[CreatedOnDate] ,t.[LastModifiedByUserID] ,t.[LastModifiedOnDate] ,t2.TabName ,u1.Username as CreatedBy ,u2.Username as ModifiedBy ,t.ModuleTitle ,t2.TabID ,m.DefinitionName FROM [dbo].[Modules] as a LEFT JOIN Users u1 On a.CreatedByUserID = u1.UserID LEFT JOIN Users u2 On a.LastModifiedByUserID = u2.UserID LEFT JOIN TabModules t ON a.ModuleID = t.ModuleID LEFT JOIN Tabs t2 on t.TabID = t2.TabID LEFT JOIN ModuleDefinitions m ON m.ModuleDefID = a.ModuleDefID Where a.ModuleID = t.ModuleID
